lines: We seemed to have been recognized by the nekobitama grass as full-blown enemies.
Just from trying to approach it, we had thorny burrs shot at us.
「How about we make it fire all its burrs, and pull it out when it's defenceless?」
「Okay, okay...... Honestly. This hurts, you know!!」
As I would expect from her, Hebiko understood the strategy right away, and, despite grumbling complaints, went out in front of us.
She made a show of waving her octopus legs, at which point red burrs flew at her immediately.
The sharp burrs were fired one after another, and stuck into Hebiko's legs. And then――
As soon as she saw it was out of projectiles, she immediately rushed in and tried to reap the grass with her kodachi.
However, what was sent flying was her octopus leg, still clutching the short sword.
In an instant, the nekobitama grass had sharpened and hardened its leaves like blades, then cut off Hebiko's leg and sent it flying.
「So it doesn't just hurl its burrs; it can even make its leaves into blades. That's a Demon World grass for you.」
「Hey, Fuuma-chan! Is this any time to be impressed?!」
Even while we were doing all this, the nekobitama grass had grown burrs in a flash, and gone back to the way it was before.
「This tactic isn't gonna work, huh? I wonder what can be done......」
Koro-senpai, who had been watching intently, put her hand on her sword and stepped softly forward.
She had probably called out the name of some kind of move. With a quiet cry, Koro-senpai's sword swept across the ground.
In a cloud of dust, the grass was cut down, and the ground was made barren.
「Amazing...... I couldn't see that at all.」
Despite how she looked, she was a Stray Blade Style swordsman, like Rinko-senpai.
And, she also possessed considerable skill.
「Whisper-whisper (That's Koro-senpai for you. She's so daring.)」
「Murmur-murmur (There's no need for us to whisper too, Hebiko.)」
Overwhelmed, we were instinctively hushing our voices.
Nao-senpai walked calmly across the ground, which had been made barren, and tried to pick the root of the nekobitama grass with her slender fingers――
Noticing something strange, I rushed out, but I was a moment too late.
One of the reaped leaves hardened, and flew toward her eyes.
Nao-senpai quickly dodged, and it ended up just grazing the bottom of her neck, but――
「Even after it's been cut. This is some formidable life force.」
「This might be dangerous for us to do alone. Let's call some Wood Escape-using student too.」
When I looked back, she was silent, hanging her head and casting her eyes down at the ground.
Her shoulders appeared to be trembling slightly.
Upon closer inspection, the collar of Nao-senpai's blouse was minutely cut.
「S-Since Senpai goes on missions, isn't it normal to have your Taimanin suit get torn?」
Wounds and injuries were an everyday occurrence for Taimanin. Sometimes they even lost parts of their bodies.
Not to mention that Nao-senpai was one of the outstanding Taimanin who sometimes went on missions with the adults.
When I asked her that without thinking, she teared up a little.
「It's all right if it's my Taimanin suit. I'm a Taimanin—I'm not expecting to get away with my body unscathed.」
「I fine-tuned it in detail myself, so I could at least spend my quiet everyday life being cute.」
「Come to think of it, Nao-senpai, the collar on your blouse is just a teensy bit big, isn't it?」
「Yeah, this way's cuter with the short hair, don't you think?」
Perhaps happy for that to be noticed, Nao-senpai brightened her expression slightly.
Now that she mentioned it, I did get the feeling it was a little larger than Hebiko and Koro-senpai's.
（The shape of a shirt looks quiet different, depending on the size of your chest――）
「Gosha Academy has people who dress up in a variety of different ways, doesn't it? Lots of them spend all day in their Taimanin suit.」
Due to its unique circumstances, Gosha Academy was relatively lenient when it came to clothing.
There were even students who came in their personal clothes after returning from a mission, like Rinko-senpai today.
「But my uniform is still cute. And it's clothing I can only wear now.」
「In which case, I want to wear those cute clothes and make them even cuter.」
「It's not just the collar. I made fine adjustments to the hem and the sleeves, too. Cuteness is something you craft, after all.」
「I'm a third-year. There's only a little more time I'll get to wear this uniform......」
Perhaps because she was considerably pissed off, Nao-senpai sharply raised her teary eyes, and
「How dare you do that to me?! Focus, light! Light Escape Art!!!」
Activated her “Light Escape Arts”, at which point the faint winter sunlight that filtered through the trees focused in her hands.
And then, it grew blinding in no time――
――After a while, sensing that the light had subsided, we tried opening them, and
On the ground in front of Nao-senpai, the grass had completely wilted.
Like this, it probably wasn't going to be shooting its leaves anymore.
「Amazing...... I knew nekobitama grass was weak to heat, but still......」
「......Shouldn't you have done this from the beginning?」
Minasaki, who had been hiding somewhere, slowly came out and said.
「I guess so...... W-Well, this is a case of “All's well that ends well.”」
After that, we waited for the heated ground to cool off, and collected the nekobitama grass roots.
We went back to my house, and immediately made chocolate with nekobitama grass in it.
We set it out in front of Mercy and the other addicted cats, who had been waiting lethargically.
Mercy got a different look in her eyes, seeing the chocolate.
Even though she knew it had the antidote in it, when we put chocolate in front of her, she still seemed to lose her senses.
Mercy and the cats pounced at the chocolate, and ate it single-mindedly.
For a while, only the sounds of eating chocolate resounded.
And then, all of a sudden, the looks on the faces of Mercy and the cats changed.
「What is this, nya......?! I-It's bitter...... Awful......」
She writhed and groaned with a grim expression, and started rolling on the floor.
The cats were also variously throwing up or writhing around, and straight after that, they passed out, one after another.
「The cait-sith is one thing, but I don't want these cute cats to die.」
Hebiko and Nao-senpai looked with concern at the cats, who were in the middle of making agonized cries.
Eventually, all the cats had fainted, and anxiety had begun to hang over the quiet room, when
「Haah...... Th-That was horrible, nya...... I've been traumatized, nya......」
「Thanks to that, I've snapped out of it, nya. I never wanna even see chocolate again, nya......」
「Come on, everyone, wake up, nya. Us alley cats are gonna go back and tough it out in Yomihara from tomorrow on, nya!」
One by one, the cats also woke up, and left while grumbling meows.
「I guess that means the addiction's been cured, at any rate.」
Hebiko and the others seemed a little uneasy due to this abrupt ending.
「I wonder if it's like one of those strong anti-alcohol drugs, as it were......」
「They sometimes use drugs that make you feel sick when you drink, to treat alcoholism.」
「Basically, as you have bad experiences because of that, you lose the desire to drink.」
Judging from how they had almost passed out from one dose, the effect must have been beyond compare, though.
「Well, everyone, thanks! Now I have a good excuse to give Miriam, too!」
「Mumble-mumble (This crow is the root cause of all this...... Should I slay this harmful demon?)」
「?! I couldn't catch that clearly, but you're saying something dicey, aren't you?!」
Minasaki ran around trying to escape, and Koro-senpai went after her. I was purposely standing by and watching, without stopping her.
「Mutter-mutter (Well, that girl could do with suffering a little, right?)」
「Whisper-whisper (Hebiko doesn't think we need to whisper too, Fuuma-chan.)」
And so, the day after we had successfully cured (?) the addicted cats.
I heard the sound of Tokiko knocking on my door.
With great pains, I just barely squeezed my voice out.
「P-Put it around...... there, for now...... uugh...」
「O-Okay...... Lord-sama, is something the matter? May I open the door?」
The door hesitantly opened, and she poked her face in with the package.
Having seen me, Tokiko went pale and rushed over to me. It was no wonder.
Because, even though it was wintertime, I was lying curled up on the floor, holding my stomach and groaning.
「Lord-sama?! What's wrong?! Are you in pain somewhere?!」
With great effort, I raised my arm, and pointed at the truffle chocolate on the table.
They were the chocolates that Hebiko gave me. She had told me that they made them together, so of course Tokiko would recognize them too.
「Tokiko, is it true that you made those with Hebiko......?」
「She told me she wanted to put the cream filling in herself, so I only did the outside, though......」
「I see. So that was the trap......」
She tried picking up one of the truffles.
It was giving off a pungent smell, and a green lump and an octopus sucker were peeking out.
「Hih......?! This is... raw octopus and...... wasabi, isn't it?」
「Yeah, that's not all. Salted, fermented octopus paste, deep-fried octopus............ Blegh. 'Scuse me, I'm gonna be sick!」
I made a dash for the toilet, for the umpteenth time today.
（I can't believe I've gone through the same thing as the cats. I don't want to see chocolate for a good long while......）
From outside, I could hear the sounds of Tokiko running to the kitchen in search of medicine.
（Valentine's Day really is tough for Taimanin......）
I thought sincerely, in the winter bathroom, where the cold seeped in.
